ps_skill: skill "../escape": the name is not a single folder name
ps_nodesc: Antigravity does not load a skill without a description
ps_cred: skill file scripts/token.json matches the credential exclusion list
ps_cmd: the command has no prompt
ps_cmdname: the name has no characters usable in a file name
ps_cmddesc: Antigravity does not load a skill without a description
ps_sub: Antigravity needs a description for a subagent
ps_builtin: "research" is a built in Antigravity agent name
ps_allow: Antigravity cannot restrict MCP servers to an allow list
ps_native: Antigravity native permission entries are not supported
ps_foreign: nothing in this permission applies to Antigravity
ps_hook: no antigravity native entry
ps_hookname: the name has no characters usable in a hook name
ps_nomcp: the item has no server definition
ps_sse: transport "sse" is not supported by Antigravity
ps_both: an http server needs a url and no command, args or env
ps_bare: a stdio server needs a command and no url or headers
